newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: SOCCER-POBORSKY, BERGER SHARE PLAYER OF YEAR AWARD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-POBORSKY, BERGER SHARE PLAYER OF YEAR AWARD.

text.p: Karel Poborsky and Patrik Berger, who played key roles in taking their country to the Euro 96 final, have been voted joint winners of the Czech footballer of the year award.

Poborsky has struggled to reproduce the form he showed during the European championship finals in his first season with Manchester United, a problem which has been exacerbated by his inability to speak English.
At Sunday's awards ceremony, the moderator referred to media speculation that Poborsky was living through "hell" in England because he could not commmunicate with his team mates or management.
"Do you know what the English word for hell is" asked the moderator. "No. I don't speak English," Poborsky replied.
In contrast, Berger has made a valuable contribution to Liverpool's premier league title challenge this season.
The prize was awarded on the basis of votes from Czech football league managers, sports journalists and the Czech-Moravian Football Association.
